background: Edit the provided selected MODEL 3 coal tunnel concept into its FINAL GAME BACKGROUND. Preserve the exact 16:9 composition, pixel art style, dark blue-black coal, timber and riveted iron supports, warm oil lamps, horizontal floor level, far-left shaft guides, low drainage pipe and far-right coal seam/crate/pickaxe. Make ONLY these production changes: (1) completely remove the straw-hat character, reconstruct natural rock behind him; (2) remove ALL airborne falling rocks, falling dust, particle streaks and suspended debris from the three hazard bays, reconstruct the still coal wall and roof behind them; keep just modest small resting rubble along the rear foot of the wall; (3) remove the entire movable wooden elevator cage, its lantern and gate at the far left, leaving a dark empty open shaft, fixed vertical iron guides, hanging rope, and an unobstructed lift landing whose floor aligns with the single corridor floor. Keep the shaft unobstructed so a separate moving cage sprite can be drawn over it. No new characters, no UI, no text, no arrows. Do not change viewpoint or layout. The tunnel remains a close, strictly side-on horizontal corridor, not a huge hall. Crisp professional pixel clusters; no blurred painting. Output opaque full background.
parts:
Using the attached coal tunnel MODEL 3 image as STYLE REFERENCE only, create a transparent-background professional PIXEL ART 2x2 game sprite atlas, exactly four equal square cells, each object fully contained in its own cell with generous clear transparent margins, no cross-cell overlap, no labels, no text, no outlines around cells.
Top left: a SMALL antique mine elevator cage in strict FRONT ELEVATION, honey-brown timber reinforced with dark riveted iron. Rectangular tall frame, two narrow posts, top crossbeam with central rope attachment, wooden rear wall, heavy floor platform. FRONT OPEN: no gate, no crossbar across its entrance, no person. Height approximately 1.7 human heights, wide enough for a single chibi person. Warm amber light on the wood, dark iron corner braces. No shaft, no background building, no attached ground, no exterior lantern.
Top right: the matching SEPARATE sliding gate for that cage, a waist-high wide rectangular wooden panel made of short vertical planks, riveted dark iron top and bottom straps, two small hinge fittings. FRONT ELEVATION, width equal to the inside of the cage. It will slide downward to close in front of the player, so keep a clear stand-alone silhouette.
Bottom left: a single small flanged iron mine hoist pulley wheel, FRONT ELEVATION circular with 5 spokes, central bronze bearing, grooved dark iron rim. No ropes, no support tower or background.
Bottom right: ONE small irregular grey-black shale/coal rock, roughly fist-sized, angular silhouette, readable facets and subtle cold-grey highlights. No pile, no dust, no shadow painted outside the rock. Used for falling small stones.
Match the exact wood, iron and coal style of the reference. Crisp pixel art, visible crafted pixel clusters, no smooth vector graphics, no modern components. Preserve full alpha transparency outside each object.
